title: Discrete Heisenberg–Weyl group and modular group
abstract: It is shown that the generators of two discrete Heisenberg-Weyl groups with irra- tional rotation numbers θ and −1/θ generate the whole algebra B of bounded operators on L2(R). The natural action of the modular group in B is implied. Applications to dynamical algebras appearing in lattice regularization and some duality principles are discussed.
